Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production cutout character texture sheet for the clown in a lightweight Godot 2D circus game.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED character design reference. Match the CLOWN in its top row closely: charming round face, red round nose, red curly hair at the sides, black tilted top hat with cream daisy and gold ribbon, warm cream ruff, broad red/cream harlequin checks, two gold buttons, brown oversized circus shoes with cream soles, cream cartoon gloves. Rich hand-inked 1930s animation drawing with subtle painted shading and cloth folds; NOT a flat geometric icon.
Create a genuinely TRANSPARENT landscape PNG laid out as a clean 3 columns x 2 rows grid with equal cells and generous transparent gutters. No visible grid or labels.
EXACT layout, each isolated component centered inside its own cell, all pointing RIGHT:
TOP LEFT: complete clown HEAD ONLY, including top hat, daisy, hair, entire face and small neck stub. Eyes OPEN. Three-quarter right-facing profile like the reference. No collar or body.
TOP CENTER: clown TORSO ONLY, from cream ruffled collar through the round baggy checked romper ending in TWO short scalloped trouser cuffs. No head, arms, gloves, long legs, or shoes. Broad asymmetric curved red/cream checks following round belly, two gold buttons, folds. Keep both sides of collar visible.
TOP RIGHT: one oversized brown SHOE ONLY, heel at left, toe at right, wide cream sole and cream ankle cuff at upper left. Side view, very broad, low shoe like the reference.
BOTTOM LEFT: exact duplicate of TOP LEFT head with only eyelids changed to eyes CLOSED, preserving all contours, dimensions, pose, hat, hair, neck and face alignment pixel-perfect. Full head, not just eyelids.
BOTTOM CENTER: one curled cream GLOVE FIST ONLY with a small cuff on the left, fingers oriented right, charming drawn folds and ink strokes. No arm.
BOTTOM RIGHT: cream GLOVED HAND gripping the small wooden CORK PISTOL, cuff at far left and barrel pointing horizontally to the RIGHT, muzzle center halfway down on right edge. Brown warm wood, brass hoop and flared circular muzzle, cork at mouth. Wrist at left, trigger hand at left-middle, barrel occupies right two thirds. No arm, no bullet, no smoke.
Constraints: each part isolated, no overlaps or shadows outside its silhouette; consistent dark warm outlines and reference colors; crisp readable cartoon ink with fine warm painted texture; do not copy paper backdrop; no text, symbols, diagram arrows, watermark, UI, extra parts, full assembled figure, duplicate objects. Transparent background, alpha cutouts. Cell gutters clear. Heads upright, torso upright, shoes and gun horizontal.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE production cutout character texture sheet for the acrobat in a lightweight Godot 2D circus game.
Input image 1 is the APPROVED character design. Match the ACROBAT in the bottom row closely. Input image 2 is the new clown texture sheet, used ONLY for matching ink weight, warm shading, texture, and technical component layout.
Acrobat: elegant smiling human face in a three-quarter RIGHT-facing profile, large expressive pie-cut cartoon eyes with long lashes, small red nose, soft rose cheek, glossy black hair in a neat high rounded bun, golden ribbon around bun, gold star earring, teal blue-petrol leotard with curved gold neckline and large gold star at waist, gold scalloped trim, teal heels with small gold ankle strap and gold toe pompom. Charming hand-inked 1930s animation drawing with subtle painted shading, NOT flat geometric vector shapes or an icon.
Genuinely TRANSPARENT landscape PNG. A clean 3 columns x 2 rows grid of equal cells, generous transparent gutters, no visible grid or labels.
EXACT layout, each isolated component centered inside its cell:
TOP LEFT: complete HEAD ONLY including bun, hair, face, star earring, small neck stub, eyes OPEN, looking RIGHT, like bottom-left acrobat reference. No shoulders or body.
TOP CENTER: TORSO ONLY, from bare upper shoulders and small straps to leotard gold fringe at hips. No neck or head, no arms, no gloves, no long legs, no shoes. Elegant hourglass teal bodice, gold neckline, waist star, shaped fabric folds. Make bare shoulders join at left and right top corners. Leotard silhouette slightly asymmetric three-quarter right view, but upright centered.
TOP RIGHT: ONE teal high-heel SHOE ONLY, right-facing side view; heel at left, toe with round gold pompom at right; gold ankle strap on upper left. Broad enough for a foot, not an elongated stiletto. Match reference.
BOTTOM LEFT: exact duplicate of TOP LEFT head with ONLY eyes now CLOSED. Same contours, pixel-aligned bun, ribbon, earring, face, nose, smile and neck. Full head not eyelids alone.
BOTTOM CENTER: ONE curled cream GLOVE FIST ONLY with little cuff at left and fingers pointing right, matching clown glove styling.
BOTTOM RIGHT: ONE cream gloved hand holding a wooden CORK PISTOL, right-facing side view. Wrist cuff at far left; gun barrel on right two thirds, barrel axis DEAD HORIZONTAL, flared gold/brass muzzle at right with cork, muzzle center at vertical middle. Brown wood, fine engraving. No forearm, bullet, smoke or flash.
Constraints: consistent reference identity and black-warm outlines, clean distinct isolated parts with no touching or overlap, real alpha transparency, crisp readable illustration and soft warm hand-painted texture inside shapes, no paper backdrop, no ground, no text, UI, logos, watermark, extra figures or parts. Head and torso upright, shoe and gun horizontal. Do not change character identity.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE replacement texture, transparent gloved hand holding cork pistol.
Input 1 is the EXISTING GAME TEXTURE to redesign. Input 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY (the painted clown sheet).
Redraw the input 1 hand and pistol with the beautifully inked, warm painted detail of input 2, preserving input 1's technical orientation and layout. Side view facing RIGHT. Broad cream cartoon glove and cuff at far LEFT, curled gloved fingers around a wooden handle at left-middle, long wooden tapered cork pistol with brass bands occupying the RIGHT two thirds.
CRITICAL technical invariants: barrel center axis perfectly HORIZONTAL; open flared muzzle is at the far RIGHT, centered at approximately 46 percent down the overall asset height. The wrist cuff is at far LEFT at the same vertical middle. Do NOT tilt the gun upward. Both muzzle and cuff centers share the same horizontal line. The pistol handle and curled fingers extend below the barrel. Keep the original roughly 96:50 (1.92:1) overall width to height silhouette ratio. Fit the complete gun and glove inside a wide horizontal area with transparent margins, centered on a landscape image. Muzzle vertical dark opening with a SMALL cork visible, not protruding far outside the rim.
Style: charming 1930s cartoon cel illustration, organic hand-drawn dark warm ink contours, ivory glove with soft folds, warm brown wood with subtle grain, gold brass highlights. Full opaque color within shapes and soft antialiased edges, genuine transparent alpha outside.
Constraints: only one pistol and one gripping glove, no forearm, no body, no bullets, no muzzle flash, no smoke, no cast shadow, no background, no grid, no labels, text or watermark. Preserve the silhouette landmarks and horizontal aiming of input 1; improve drawing and painted materials only.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: ONE transparent cutout torso texture for a 2D game acrobat.
Input image 1 shows the OLD TORSO silhouette and which body fragment is required; input image 2 is the approved character design; input image 3 is the NEW PAINTED STYLE reference.
Create a refined inked and softly painted replacement for only the acrobat TORSO. Match the teal leotard from the approved character reference: teal blue-petrol curved bodice, thin gold straps, shaped sweetheart gold neckline, large gold star centered at the waist, subtle curved seams and cloth shading, golden zigzag scalloped trim around both hip openings. Keep the waist slim and the shoulder and hip silhouette like input 1.
CRITICAL: only torso from flat-cut bare upper shoulders/collarbone through the complete pointed leotard CROTCH and gold hip trim. NO head, neck, arms, hands, gloves, thighs, legs or feet. No bare thigh stubs beneath the suit. Torso ends entirely at the ink-outlined gold-trimmed leotard bottom. Include the small upper bare shoulder/chest region with a shallow neck cutout at top center and thin straps. Torso is upright and centered, basically front view with a subtle right-facing three-quarter feel. Anatomically modest circus costume, exactly the original fictional design. No gold buttons on chest.
Beautiful charming 1930s cartoon cel illustration with dark warm organic outlines, soft warm highlights and painted fabric texture, consistent with image 3, NOT a flat icon.
Transparent alpha background, complete isolated single torso, no shadow outside the object, no text, no grid, no labels, no watermark, no extra parts or characters. Keep about 72:82 (0.878:1) overall canvas proportions and generous transparent margins.
